children: Permianville Royalty announced a monthly cash distribution of $0.016000 per unit payable October 14, 2026, to unitholders of record on September 30, 2026. The distribution is based on the Trust’s net profits interest calculations using reported oil production for June 2026 and natural gas production for May 2026 and includes accrued costs through July 2026. The Sponsor released $0.3 million of a prior $2.0 million reserve for future development and reported a partial sale of non‑producing acreage with proceeds to be included in a future distribution.
Monthly cash distribution: $0.016000 per unit payable October 14, 2026.
Recorded oil cash receipts (current month): $3.9 million on realized wellhead price of $92.96 per barrel.
Recorded natural gas cash receipts (current month): $1.2 million on realized wellhead price of $2.21 per Mcf.
Total accrued operating expenses (current month): $2.9 million.
Net profits interest calculation used underlying oil volumes for June 2026 and natural gas volumes for May 2026, with accrued costs through July 2026.
Underlying reported production: oil volumes of 42,472 barrels (1,416 Bbls/D) and natural gas volumes of 554,438 Mcf (17,885 Mcf/D) for the current month calculation.
Sponsor indicated increased potential for drilling activity on the Underlying Properties due to an uptick in oil prices, prompting higher current-month capital spending.
Sponsor released $0.3 million of a previously disclosed $2.0 million cash reserve for approved future development expenses; $1.8 million remains reserved for expected billed development expenses.

Sponsor completed a partial sale of non‑producing acreage in September 2026 for $0.3 million (free and clear of the Trust’s net profits interest); proceeds attributable to the Trust, net of sale and legal expenses, will be included in an upcoming monthly distribution.

title: Permianville Royalty Announces $0.016/unit October Distribution; June oil, May gas underpin payout
